_comment: Placeholder content overlay. The real values live in content.local.json (git-ignored). suite_root is the folder holding the media library. nau_status_file is optional: the full path to Fun Time's nau_status.txt (in its state_dir), the file Nau publishes what it is playing into -- it lets the launcher prefill a new session from whatever the main player is showing, and omitting it simply opens the launcher blank.
